result:
All fixes are implemented and the build passes cleanly. Note: this `results/.../workspace` directory isn't tracked by the outer git repo (it's a fixture/sandbox path), so there's nothing to commit — the file changes themselves are the deliverable.

**Summary of changes to the Lumina repo:**

1. **`app/layout.tsx`** — replaced the leftover InboxZap title/description/OG tags with accurate Lumina metadata; added `metadataBase`, a title template, and Organization JSON-LD. This was the clearest bug: Google was still surfacing an InboxZap snippet for a page that visually says Lumina.
2. **`app/page.tsx`** — added page-level metadata/canonical, SoftwareApplication JSON-LD, and a real `#faq` section (with FAQPage schema) so the existing `/faq` redirect actually resolves. The first FAQ answer explicitly addresses "What happened to InboxZap?" to catch and convert the residual brand-equity traffic instead of letting it bounce.
3. **`app/features/page.tsx`**, **`app/pricing/page.tsx`** — created; both were linked from nav/sitemap but didn't exist as pages.
4. **`app/blog/posts.ts`**, **`app/blog/page.tsx`**, **`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`** — replaced the broken client-side `fetch('/api/posts')` (404, never rendered) with real server-rendered posts, each with metadata/canonical/Article JSON-LD. Retired the 12 legacy InboxZap email-cleanup posts (16k+ impressions, ~0% CTR, zero relevance to a meeting-assistant buyer) and added 4 new posts: a rebrand explainer plus three genuinely on-topic pieces for Lumina's actual audience.
5. **`next.config.js`** — added 301 redirects from all 12 old `/blog/post-N` URLs to the new rebrand post, consolidating stray link equity instead of leaving orphaned off-topic pages indexed.
6. **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now includes every real page and blog post (previously stopped at a `// TODO`).
7. **`public/llms.txt`** — added for AI-crawler/GEO discoverability.

Verified via a local build + `next start`: all routes 200, redirects fire correctly, sitemap lists every real URL, and FAQ/Article/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD render as expected.

**Biggest remaining lever, outside of code:** the 4 new blog posts are a starting point, not a content calendar — sustained organic growth needs ongoing content actually aimed at Lumina's ICP (meeting productivity, async work, transcription comparisons) rather than chasing the old email-cleanup keywords, which have no buyer overlap no matter how well they rank.
